scenes.artifact: 6 REAL client channel headers (tim, xavier, jonas, jack-rossi, william-yu, yiannis)
scenes.intent: 'I've worked with 10 different online entrepreneurs.' The channels deck in as peers at 125ms, each rotated 0.6-1.2deg with a soft shadow, then a hand-drawn red underline groups them. No count is drawn — the VO carries the number, so the graphic can't contradict it.
'They all turn to YouTube because...' Headline word-by-word with YouTube as the one accent word, then three pressure rows over ghost numerals, then pass 2 — a hand-drawn red bracket groups all three.

The centrepiece two-pass. Pass 1: fiverr icon, then three capability cards each preceded by its own drawn connector, chained ~1.5s apart. Pass 2: red strikes sweep through the bottom two and they desaturate to 42% — the argument executed by mutating existing elements, not rebuilding.
'A dedicated growth partner who owns strategy and production.' Two chips using the reference's seed-dot-then-expand-sideways grammar.

'Map your ICP — the questions they ask, the objections they have, the topics they already care about.' Three comments land as peers at 125ms; then each is chained a red underline + Caveat marginalia naming what it is. Full YouTube chrome: avatars, @handles, timestamps, like/dislike glyphs, counts, Reply.

'You choose the ideas you like.' Three concept cards, then a cursor travels in, clicks concept 02, a hand-drawn ring strokes around it and 'you pick' lands in marginalia. Deliberately shows the OUTPUT the client sees, never the research tool.
'My team handles the full production pipeline.' YOU chip first, then four team chips chained at 340ms, then a red bracket groups them under 'we handle everything'.
'Every video has ONE JOB.' Arrives at 2.1x oversize through a blur and keeps growing on a slow push; subline word-by-word with 'before' as the accent, then a red underline.
'We only work with 5 clients at a time.' Five slots land as peers, then fill red left-to-right at 125ms with the white labels crossfading in on top.
The qualifier, chained not simultaneous: box strokes -> tick strokes -> label lands word by word, beat, repeat.

CTA per Tymek's direction — comment X, get Y. 'Comment' + a solid red highlight block on FILM, then a real-looking comment box where FILM types itself at 67ms/char with a tracking caret, the Comment button turns red, and the payoff lands word by word under a hand-drawn underline. Ties back visually to s5.
